events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` `#message` (subscribe result), `public/login.html` `#login-error` and `public/signup.html` `#signup-error` have no `role` or `aria-live`, so results are never read aloud.

## What to do

1. Add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` to `#message` and `role="alert"` to the error paragraphs.
2. Assert the attributes in `tests/test_dashboard_frontend.py` or a new test.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All three regions have live-region semantics
- [ ] Test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-newsletter
```
